rawFindings.title: Incorrect parent directory extraction from pattern
rawFindings.explanation: The simplified regular expression replacement in baseDirFromPattern() removes everything from the first occurrence of '*' or '(' onwards, which does not correctly handle more complex glob patterns such as '!(...)', '+(...)', or '(...)?' patterns properly as the previous multiple replacements did.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the previous multi-step replacement approach in baseDirFromPattern() to correctly remove special glob pattern parts for '*(...)', '!(...)', '+(...)', and '(...)?' patterns.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For pattern '/some/p/!(a|b).js', baseDirFromPattern returns '/some' instead of '/some/p'; for '/some/p+(c|bb).js' returns '/some' instead of expected '/some/p'; this can cause watcher to watch incorrect parent directories and potentially missing or mis-watching files.
